name: agent-permissions
title: Permission request
description: What an agent will touch before it first runs: each resource and action in plain verbs, once or always.

AgentPermissionRoot.description: The card and its state; the parts go inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: agent
props.description: Who asks: a name, or an Agent picker agent (`{ name, initials, tone, avatar }`).

props.name: scopes
props.description: What it asks for, one row each: `{ resource, actions, detail }`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The ticked scopes to start from. Defaults to every scope.

props.name: onAllow
props.description: Allow once (`once`) or Always allow (`always`), with the ticked scopes. Return a promise and the button shows a Spinner until it settles; if it rejects, the request stays as it was.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Don't allow. A promise works as for `onAllow`.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus Don't allow, the safest answer, when the request appears. Defaults to true inside a Dialog and false elsewhere, so a request arriving in a chat never takes the keys from someone typing.

AgentPermissionHeader.description: The agent's avatar in a tile of its tone, over an aura of the same tone, and "<agent> wants to:" centred under it, with why it asks. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it asks, in a sentence: "To screen this week's applicants for Product Designer."

AgentPermissionScopeList.description: The scopes as a list, one row each, kept apart by space rather than rules. Without children it lists `scopes`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `ul`.

AgentPermissionScope.description: One scope: its verb as an icon, its title and detail, and a Checkbox. The whole row is the Checkbox's label. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: scope
props.description: The scope this row asks for. Its tick is the `value` entry under its id.

AgentPermissionFooter.description: The answers: Don't allow, then Allow once with Always allow in its menu. While some scopes are unticked, how many are left sits on the other side. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

AgentPermissionRequest.description: The request from props: the header, the scopes and the answers. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it asks, in a sentence under the title.
